description: This file is a CMake script used to locate and configure the Nexus library within a build system. It defines how to find the Nexus library, set up target properties, and handle different modes of Nexus usage (proxy or client).

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for a file named nexus_config.h within specified path suffixes.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates a library such as nexus, nexus_client, nxclient, or b_os.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes another CMake module, here used for FindPackageHandleStandardArgs.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard package finding logic, setting NEXUS_FOUND accordingly.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to hide them in GUIs.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Defines an imported library target for NEXUS::NEXUS.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for CMake targets, such as include directories and locations.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Outputs status or error messages during configuration.
